name: Seireiko ~Mireille no Namida~
source:
Main character majors in fantasy university at a university in France. His research brings him to a forest lake where he meets beautiful girl Mireille who visited him in his dreams. When he kissed the girl he had no idea he was kissing spirit of the lake. The fairies of the lake dragged him to the bottom of the lake to a new unexplored world.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在法国的一所大学攻读幻想学。研究将他带到森林中的一座湖泊，在那里，他遇见了曾经出现在梦中的美丽少女米蕾耶。亲吻少女时，他并不知道自己吻到的其实是湖之精灵。湖中的妖精将他拖入湖底，带往一个尚无人探索的新世界。

[内容取自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
